sources.author: CadioArena
sources.text: 8 Ankle Stability Exercises for Strong & Healthy Feet 👣🔥

sources.author: PostureBluprint
sources.text:
Ankles feeling stiff? Start here

A little mobility, a little loading, and a little control can go a long way.

Save this for your next warm up or simply do it on its own

exercises.name: Toe curls over a ball
exercises.cue: Curl and release the toes over a small ball while the heel stays down.

exercises.name: Sole roll over a ball
exercises.cue: Roll a small ball along the sole with light pressure and a slow ankle movement.

exercises.name: Short-foot arch lift
exercises.cue: Keep the toes long and heel down; gently shorten the foot to lift the arch, then release.

exercises.name: Standing toe lifts
exercises.cue: Keep heels and the balls of the feet down while lifting and lowering the toes.

exercises.name: Toe-tip ankle pivots
exercises.cue: With very light pressure through the toe tips, slowly turn the raised heel side to side.

exercises.name: Toe spreading
exercises.cue: Spread the toes apart, then relax without forcing the movement.

exercises.name: Heel-supported ankle pumps
exercises.cue: Rest the heel on a low block and slowly lower and lift the forefoot.

exercises.name: Block-guided heel roll
exercises.cue: With a block alongside the inner foot, gently lift and roll the heel while the forefoot stays in contact.

exercises.name: Forefoot-on-block heel raise
exercises.cue: Support the forefoot on a low block and slowly raise and lower the heel.

exercises.name: Forefoot block tip
exercises.cue: Lift the forefoot to gently tip the adjacent lightweight block, then lower it under control.

exercises.name: Two-foot block pickup
exercises.cue: Place a lightweight block between the feet and squeeze inward to lift it slightly, then lower.

exercises.name: Toe curls over a block edge
exercises.cue: Support the foot on the block with toes over the front edge; curl the toes downward and release.

exercises.name: Block-squeeze heel raises
exercises.cue: Hold a lightweight block between the ankles while slowly raising and lowering both heels.

exercises.name: Tucked-toe rock on a block
exercises.cue: Rest the curled toe surfaces lightly on the block and gently rock the raised heel; use only a small comfortable range.

exercises.name: Block-squeeze forefoot raises
exercises.cue: Keep the block between the ankles and heels down; raise and lower the forefeet.

exercises.name: Outer-edge foot rolls
exercises.cue: Gently roll toward the outside borders of the feet and return to flat feet; keep the movement small.

exercises.name: Calf foam rolling
exercises.cue: Support yourself on your hands with the calves over the roller; roll slowly along the calf muscles.

exercises.name: Banded ankle pumps
exercises.cue: Loop the band around the forefoot and hold the ends. Slowly point and flex the ankle with the lower leg supported on a roller.

exercises.name: Banded ankle circles
exercises.cue: With the band around the forefoot and the lower leg supported, trace slow controlled ankle circles in both directions.

exercises.name: Weighted ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Half kneel with a light kettlebell resting on the front thigh near the knee. Keep the front heel down while gently moving the knee forward over the toes.

exercises.name: Bent-knee ankle pulses
exercises.cue: Use the wall for balance, keep the standing knee bent, and make small quick heel lifts with the ball of that foot staying on the floor.

notes: Four source videos visually inspected. All 24 movement occurrences covered by 21 distinct exercise entries. Source exercise names retained for Posture Blueprint where shown; others descriptive. Before/after correction claims excluded. Workout timing is editable and not specified by the fourth video.
